distribution.description: kind, k3s, rke2 or kubesolo. A reader ignores a value it does not know.

profile.description: The catalog profile whose values the run installed.

kubernetesVersion.description: Empty when the cluster never answered.

distributionVersion.description: The release of a distribution installed on the host. kind has none.

result.description: passed or failed. A reader treats any other value as not passed.

pods.description: The idle usage of one pod of each workload the run started.

versions.description: The version of each release that the run installed.

sourceDigest.description:
The Go module hash (h1:) of the component file, or of the template directory, that the run
installed.

dependencies.description: The sourceDigest of each component that the run installed first, by ID.

addOns.description: The pinned release of each add-on that the run installed on the host, by name.

measuredAt.description: The day of the run, in UTC.

environment.description:
Environment is one run of a component or template test. distribution, profile, platform,
kubernetesVersion and distributionVersion identify it.

measuredVersion.description: MeasuredVersion is the version of a component's release or of a template's image.

platform.description: Platform is the OS and architecture of the nodes of a run.

memory.description: Memory and CPU are Kubernetes quantities in JSON, such as "22Mi" and "3m".

podUsage.description:
PodUsage is the idle usage of one pod of a workload: the median over the
workload's pods at the measurement time. Replicas and requests are not
measured; they come from the rendered objects.

kubernetesVersion.description: The Kubernetes version of the render: the newest in catalog.json kubernetes.

profiles.description: The objects of each profile. A profile where the component is unsupported is missing.

render.description:
Render is what helm template renders for each profile with the test inputs and the values that
other components contribute.

release.description: The release of the component that renders it. A volumeClaimTemplates entry has none.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PersistentVolumeClaim. A volumeClaimTemplates entry has none.

renderedClaim.description: RenderedClaim is the requested storage of a PersistentVolumeClaim.

additionalProperties.description: A Kubernetes quantity, such as 256Mi or 100m.
A Kubernetes quantity, such as 256Mi or 100m.

renderedContainer.description: RenderedContainer is the requests and limits of a container, by resource name.

renderedProfile.description: RenderedProfile is the objects of a component on one profile.

release.description: The release of the component that renders it.

kind.description: Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet. A reader ignores a value it does not know.

replicas.description: spec.replicas, 1 if not set. A DaemonSet has none: it runs one pod on each node.

volumeClaimTemplates.description: The claims that a StatefulSet makes for each pod.

renderedWorkload.description:
RenderedWorkload is a Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet. A workload that an operator creates
later is missing.

id.description: The file name of the component without .yaml.

sourceDigest.description:
The Go module hash (h1:) of components/<id>.yaml. A measurement with another sourceDigest
tested an older file.

measurements.description: Every recorded run of the component's e2e test, passed or failed.

title: components/<id>.json
description:
ComponentFile is components/<id>.json: the declaration of a component, the objects it renders
and the runs of its e2e test.
